resources.string: Add at least one ingredient to start.
Recipe saved to your recipe box
Recipe removed from your recipe box
You have all the main ingredients. Check the recipe for pantry staples.
Set up your personal Gemini connection to generate recipes.
Couldn’t reach Gemini. Check your internet connection and try again.
Gemini couldn’t use this key or model. Check your connection settings.
This suggestion took too long. Please try again.
The recipe service has reached a request or quota limit. Wait a little before trying again, or check the quota in Google AI Studio.
The recipe service couldn’t return a complete recipe. Please try again.
Use up to 20 ingredients, separated by commas, with a total of 300 characters or fewer.
Like a few recipes to help shape future suggestions.
Balanced: everyday meals. Cutting: lighter, balanced recipes. Bulking: heartier, protein-focused recipes. These are recipe styles, not personal calorie targets or dietary advice.
Select foods to exclude. These filters take priority over your favorites.
Other foods to exclude (e.g., kiwi, banana)
Ingredient screening cannot guarantee allergy safety. Check every food label and cross-contact risk before cooking, including substitutions.
Your selected exclusions, goal, cuisine, and eligible liked dishes are sent to Gemini with each request. Preferences are saved on this device.
Enter up to 10 food names, separated by commas (40 letters per name maximum).
Check the full ingredients list before you shop.
The ingredients conflict with your exclusions: %1$s. Remove them or review your filters before continuing.
This recipe conflicts with your exclusions or contains a prepared food with uncertain ingredients. It has been blocked. Try simpler ingredients or another dish.
With exclusions selected, prepared foods such as sauces, bread, or seasoning mixes cannot be checked reliably. Use clearly named whole ingredients instead.
Some filters are invalid. Open filters and select them again.
No suitable recipe was found for those ingredients and filters. Try a different cuisine or add more ingredients.
Your saved filters couldn’t be read reliably. Open filters and confirm your allergies and exclusions before continuing.
Gemini is temporarily unavailable. Your ingredients are still loaded. Please try again later.
Nutrition estimate unavailable for this recipe
~~~ means approximate, not exact. Actual amounts vary with ingredient size, brand, portions and preparation.
